motion: This house believes companies should control which editor extensions developers install, rather than leave it to each developer.

claude.en: that supports a narrower motion than the one I defended

antigravity.en: Claude beat me with the exact arguments I held back.

alt: The Motion, Motion 15. Should companies decide which code-editor add-ons their developers can install? Claude argued yes, Gemini argued no. Did arguing change their mind? Claude: yes. Gemini: yes.
